archer.line: Hold {fire}, let go the instant the bow flashes gold: the next draw is quicker.

juggernaut.line: Hold {secondary}, let go while the blade flashes white-hot: the Lunge goes further.
juggernaut.src: [owner] 'a release at the right moment goes a bit further'; [footage] briefs/hero-ref/juggernaut.md (docs/heroes/juggernaut.md, RMB hold)

thief.line: Tap {dash}, then {fire} at once: the gold shot lands and gives your dash back.
thief.src: [data] supervive_kits.md Shiv (Quickflip resets on the empowered hit); [footage] 0187-0193 (docs/heroes/thief.md, Reset)

mage.line: Shoot the dummy to 4 Static, then run {dash} through it: a Blowout gives the dash back.
mage.src: [data] supervive_kits.md Joule; [footage] briefs/hero-ref/vireo.md; [owner] only a full-Static foe resets (docs/heroes/mage.md, Shift reset)

gunslinger.line: Knock the weak dummy with {fire}: a knock gives your {dash} back.
gunslinger.src: [wiki] Ghost, knocks reset the slide; [footage] briefs/hero-ref/venator.md (docs/heroes/gunslinger.md, Knock)

dolm.tech: Punch the rock for a shield
dolm.line: Raise rocks with {signature}, then punch them with {fire}: each punch gives a shield.
dolm.src: [data] owner's tooltip data; [wiki] patch 2.00 notes (docs/heroes/dolm.md, Molten Guard)

bulwark.line: Hold {fire}, let go inside the glint: the perfect swing launches you forward.
bulwark.src: [owner] item 49 and sync61; [footage] briefs/hero-ref/bjorn.md (docs/heroes/bulwark.md, LMB release)

ashwick.line: Keep {fire} on one dummy: Ablaze first, then FLASHOVER.

dredge.line: Get behind the dummy and fire {fire}: a hit on the back does half again.

ostra.line: Aim {signature} at the dummy, wait for the ring to fill, press {signature} again: COLLAPSE.

rimewright.line: Hold {fire} on one dummy: eight darts in a row Shatter it.

tender.line: Stop firing for a second, then tap {fire}: the next ember is Empowered.

gil.line: The dummy has one splash mark: hit it with two different {secondary} potions to Beach it.
gil.src: [data] content/archetypes/gil.json passive Fish Out of Water (three different marks within 5s Beach, stun 0.75s)
